language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Chip. Let's see what Maya is doing in her grandfather's shop this Sunday.
Hello, my name is Maya. This is my grandfather's shop, 'Tasty Treats' in New Market.
Do you know, this is the most popular shop in the whole food market! Our shop sells various types of patties, sweets and savouries.
On Sundays, when there are too many customers, I help my grandfather prepare the patties and sweets.
Today I'm going to help my grandfather make triangular patties.
He has given me dough that is square shaped. He explains that any square can be divided into two equal triangles by drawing a diagonal line through the middle.
This means that the area of each resulting triangle is exactly half the area of the original square. Are you going to help me cut the dough?
